::: {.callout-tip}
## SCpubr is community-maintained
**SCpubr** is in maintenance mode — active feature development has concluded, but the project is very much alive through bug fixes, compatibility updates, and community contributions.
:::

## How to contribute

There are many ways to help, regardless of your experience level:

| Contribution | How |
|---|---|
| **Report a bug** | Open an [issue on GitHub](https://github.com/enblacar/SCpubr/issues) with a minimal reproducible example. |
| **Suggest an improvement** | Start a [discussion](https://github.com/enblacar/SCpubr/issues) describing what you'd like to see. |
| **Submit a pull request** | Fork the repo, make your changes, and open a [PR](https://github.com/enblacar/SCpubr/pulls). |
| **Improve documentation** | Typos, clearer examples, new vignettes — all welcome! |

## Guidelines

- Please be respectful and constructive in all interactions.
- When submitting code, ensure `R CMD check` passes without errors.
- Follow the existing code style and naming conventions.

## Contact

For questions or suggestions: `scpubr@gmail.com`
